reconstructed_theorem_text: For every natural number n with n >= 3, every real number kappa with kappa >= 4, and every real orthogonal n-by-n matrix O, define A = ((kappa + 1)/2) I_n - ((kappa - 1)/4)(O + O^T). The centered multivariate Gaussian measure on real n-dimensional Euclidean space with covariance A^(-1) equals the measure having density sqrt(det A)/(2*pi)^(n/2) times exp(-(x^T A x)/2) with respect to canonical Euclidean volume. The equality is equality of measures; the density is interpreted through the nonnegative extended-real embedding, the square root is nonnegative, and n/2 in the exponent is real division.
objects: The dimension n, real parameter kappa, orthogonal matrix O, identity matrix I_n, symmetric matrix A = ((kappa + 1)/2) I_n - ((kappa - 1)/4)(O + O^T), its inverse A^(-1), the centered Gaussian with that covariance, canonical Euclidean volume, and the displayed density.
domains: n is a natural number; kappa is real; O belongs to the real orthogonal group on Fin n; A and its inverse are real n-by-n matrices; x ranges over real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its canonical inner product; both sides are measures on that space.
quantifiers: Universally for every n satisfying 3 <= n, every kappa satisfying 4 <= kappa, and every real orthogonal n-by-n matrix O. The density function is defined for every x in the associated Euclidean space.
assumptions: The only explicit hypotheses are n >= 3, kappa >= 4, and membership of O in the real orthogonal group. No separate positive-definiteness or density-normalization hypothesis is imposed.
conclusion: The centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A^(-1) is exactly Euclidean volume weighted by the nonnegative extended-real embedding of sqrt(det A)/(2*pi)^(n/2) * exp(-(x^T A x)/2).
scopes: A is shorthand for the same matrix expression throughout, depending on n, kappa, and O. The inverse applies to A as a whole, the square root applies to det A, and exp has exponent -(x^T A x)/2. The factor (2*pi) has real exponent n/2. The result is an equality of measures on the full Euclidean space.
constant_dependencies: All numerical constants are fixed: thresholds 3 and 4, coefficients involving 1, 2, and 4, and the usual pi. There are no unspecified constants or existential parameter choices. Dimension, covariance, determinant, and density depend only on n, kappa, and O as displayed.
